source: arda_forex/forex-bot-main (a friend's MT5 project); rules copied from USDJPY_Sinyal.mq5 v1.000-1.500 and research/v29_sim.py; nothing is re-tuned here
server_time: XM-style broker time = New York local time + 7h; H4 and D1 candles are rebuilt from 15M on that clock (D1 closes at 17:00 New York)
costs: measured Dukascopy median spread at the entry New York hour + 0.7 pip ECN commission, paid once (data/ml/spread_profile.json); gold: Dukascopy median ASK-BID by New York hour from the 10th-15th of each month, no commission

H1_usdjpy_h4_pullback.rule: H4 EMA20>EMA50 gives direction d; last closed server-day D1 structure (pivot 3, close beyond last confirmed pivot high/low) equals d; H4 bar touches EMA20 (low<=EMA20 for long), closes beyond EMA20 on the d side and in colour d; >=5 H4 bars since previous signal. Stop = extreme of signal bar and previous 5 bars -/+ 0.3 H4 ATR(14, Wilder). Target = close + 2 x (close - stop). Time exit at close of H4 bar k+100.
H1_usdjpy_h4_pullback.execution: decision at H4 close; fill at next 5M open; stop and target levels as in the indicator; stop wins when both touched in one 5M bar; overlapping trades allowed (the indicator scores each signal independently)
H1_usdjpy_h4_pullback.metric: net R per trade = (exit - fill) x side / (close - stop distance) - cost / risk
H1_usdjpy_h4_pullback.pass: 2009-2024 combined: >=60 trades, mean net R > 0, day-level stationary bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0, and mean net R > 0 separately in development, validation and audit
H1_usdjpy_h4_pullback.replication_check: 2025-2026 is Arda's selection window; reported, not used for the decision

H1b_same_rule_28_pairs.pass: pooled 2009-2024 passes the H1 gate and >=60% of pairs have positive mean net R; secondary, informs whether H1 is pair-specific luck

H2_gold_m15.rule: Arda's own run() from research/v29_sim.py executed unchanged through a data adapter (Dukascopy 1M -> server-time M15/M30/H1/H4, spread column from the measured gold profile)

configs.G1_scalp_all_v3000: sigScalp=True, sigTrend=False, sigDonus=False, onlyBest=False, scBrk=True, brkBody=0.5, brkBeyond=0.1, exitEma=100, trailStop=True, trailAfterTP=False (current indicator trade signal)
configs.G2_strong_trend_v2900: sigScalp=False, sigTrend=True, sigDonus=False, onlyBest=True, trEmaGate=False, brkBody=0.5, brkBeyond=0.1, exitEma=100, trailStop=True, trailAfterTP=False

H2_gold_m15.pass: per config: >=60 trades, mean net R > 0, day-level bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0, mean net R > 0 in 2020-2022 and in 2023-2024, and in at least 4 of 5 calendar years. Long and short reported separately.
H2_gold_m15.replication_check: if 2025-01..2026-10 data is available, PF is compared with Arda's notes to confirm the adapter

H3_direction_ladder.rule: structure direction (pivot 3, Arda's struct_dir) on server-time D1, H4, H1 and M30, each from its last closed bar; all four equal and non-zero gives direction
H3_direction_ladder.metric: pips from decision close to close 4 hours later in the ladder direction, minus cost
H3_direction_ladder.pass: mean net pips > 0 with day-level bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0 in each of development, validation and audit(2023-2026). Gross result and 1-hour horizon reported.

H4_shock_alert.rule: closed M15 bar with |close-open| >= 3 x mean true range of the 14 bars before it
H4_shock_alert.alert_value_pass: median of (next 4h high-low) / (median 4h high-low for the same pair and UTC start hour over the previous 60 days) >= 1.5 in each period
H4_shock_alert.direction_report: net pips 1h and 4h after the next open in the body direction; called directional only if the bootstrap interval excludes zero with the same sign in all three periods

H5_news_history_line.rule: high-impact ForexFactory events 2010-2026 with actualBetterWorse; pair map as research_news_drift (USD events on EURUSD, USDJPY, GBPUSD, AUDUSD). Outcome = sign of the pair move from the release 5M open to the close 60 minutes later, expressed for the event currency. History = earlier occurrences of the same series and better/worse side only (>=8).
H5_news_history_line.prediction: when history shows >=65% one way, predict that way for the next occurrence
H5_news_history_line.pass: hit rate of these predictions > 50% with a 95% bootstrap lower bound > 50% in each period, and higher than the naive 'better news = currency up' rule on the same events

H6_lot_guard.rule: skip when the minimum 0.01 lot already loses more than 3 x the planned risk ($1000 x 1.5%) at the stop
H6_lot_guard.test: none needed (risk arithmetic); report how many H1/H2 trades it would skip

H7_partial_exit.rule: at +1R close half and move the stop to entry; the rest keeps the 2R target/stop/time exit
H7_partial_exit.report: mean net R, worst calendar month and max drawdown in R versus the full-position baseline; offered as a plan option only if worst month and drawdown improve by >=30% while mean net R stays > 0

periods_h3_h4_h5.note: H3-H5 are display ideas, not rules fitted by Arda on 2025-26 prices, so the audit runs to the end of the data; H5 development starts 2010 (calendar archive)

data_change_before_results.reason: Dukascopy datafeed throttled to ~1 file/min (1,600 files ~ 1 day) and the jetta API answers with a bot challenge, which we do not bypass
data_change_before_results.gold_bars: HistData.com free M1 BID, 2020-01 .. 2026-10, clock EST without DST (UTC-5)
data_change_before_results.gold_spread: Dukascopy BID/ASK minute candles on the 15th of each month 2020-2024 (60 days), median by New York hour
